lines.note: Ge'ez 1 includes Greek 1 and the green-grass clause of Greek 2; Ge'ez 2 completes Greek 2 with the water-of-rest clause.
Ge'ez divides the shadow-of-death passage and the rod-and-staff clause into two verses.
Ge'ez separates the prepared table from the anointed head and cup.
Ge'ez separates mercy following throughout life from dwelling in the Lord's house.
